description.narrative: Established in 1985, Dogus Cay ve Gida Maddeleri Uretim Pazarlama Ithalat Ihracat A.S. (Dogus Cay or The Company) is a leading Turkish food and beverage (F&B) producer with a diversified portfolio spanning chips, tea, sugar, tomato paste, and soft beverages. The Company operates 15 large-scale production facilities with nationwide distribution, mainly serving modern retail and traditional trade channels in the domestic market. The project entails financing of Dogus Cays investment program in Turkiye which includes capacity increase and efficiency investments in chips operations, capacity increase in tomato paste operations and vehicle purchases for distribution operations (The Project).

The project is expected to deliver broad economic benefits by creating new jobs, contributing to Turkiyes economy through backward linkages with other sectors of the economy including agriculture, transportation, and logistics, as well as improving farmers livelihoods by expanding market access and providing technical assistance. Beyond direct outcomes, IFCs financing is anticipated to sustain competitiveness within the savory snacks of Turkiyes confectionery segment.
